title: US tech firm asks court to block CEO who fired 900 in 79-second call

Garg allegedly violated securities laws by making misleading statements to regain his position. The board unanimously removed Garg after significant company losses and stock decline. Garg seeks reinstatement, offering to work for one dollar annually.

title: BWF Worlds: Displaced by war, Yevheniia and Polina keep Ukraine's flag flying high
content: Ukrainian badminton players Yevheniia Kantemyr and Polina Buhrova were forced to flee their war-torn hometown of Kharkiv to continue their careers in Italy. Despite personal loss and displacement, they are competing at the BWF World Championships in New Delhi, proudly representing Ukraine and voicing strong opposition to Russian athletes' participation in sport.

title: US issues details of new Green Card rules coming into effect from September 18
content: Starting September 18, 2026, new regulations from the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services will affect Green Card applications, implementing a more rigorous public charge test. This means applicants will be assessed more thoroughly regarding any public benefits received. However, existing Green Card holders and certain humanitarian cases will not be subject to these enhanced evaluations.

title: FDR expanded estate to 1,500 acres, planted 500,000 trees, then gave home to US
content: President Franklin D. Roosevelt generously bequeathed his family's Springwood estate to the government, substantially enhancing the property throughout his life. By planting over 500,000 trees, Roosevelt transformed the surrounding landscape. This pivotal donation secured the lasting preservation of this notable presidential site, which became both America’s first presidential library and a cherished national historic landmark.

title: Meet 10-yr-old Hsu Ting-wei, winner of Silicon Valley invention award
content: In a remarkable showcase of talent, Taiwanese inventors made waves at the Silicon Valley International Festival. Among them, a ten-year-old prodigy captured prestigious awards with his innovative AI-powered electronic nose, designed to identify airborne chemical threats and health risks. The event highlighted the impressive achievement of Taiwanese participants, who collectively earned twenty-four gold medals, demonstrating the practical benefits of emerging technologies in daily life.

title: Akshaye Khanna set to return in 'Mahakali'
content: Akshaye Khanna will portray Shukracharya in the upcoming 'Mahakali' movie. The film is part of the Prasanth Varma Cinematic Universe. Makers announced a major reveal date for August twenty-fourth. Bhoomi Shetty and Rohit Saraf also join the cast. This project builds upon the success of 'Hanu-Man'.

title: World Test C'ship: What India's Galle win means for their road to The Oval
content: The win came in India’s first Test assignment since their 0-2 home series loss to South Africa in November last year. The rain-affected match went into the fifth day after India had taken control of the contest.

title: Aryan Nishad’s Bribes FYI shuts down after going viral, seeks help to return
content: Bribes.fyi, the crowdsourced anti-bribery platform created by Aryan Nishad, has been temporarily shut down after going unexpectedly viral, recording more than 5 million requests and around 200,000 new users in 48 hours, according to a LinkedIn update. The team says it plans to return after putting stronger legal and financial infrastructure in place. The development has also prompted calls for lawyers and Chartered Accountants to help address concerns around verification, misuse, privacy, legal risks and platform governance.

title: Manav Suthar creates history: Youngest Indian to take 10-wicket haul in away Test
content: Manav Suthar became the youngest Indian to take ten wickets in an away Test. His performance secured India's victory against Sri Lanka in Galle. Suthar joined an elite group of Indian spinners with this achievement. Captain Shubman Gill praised the young bowler's promising future contributions. This win earned India crucial World Test Championship points.

title: 2 failed attempts, video call: How 'Rs 1.2 crore testicle' claim led to teen's murder
content: A 16-year-old boy was murdered in Bhopal by a group believing his testicles were valuable. The alleged mastermind was inspired by a social media hoax about organ prices. Police recovered the decomposed body and confirmed the removal of body parts. Divers are searching two lakes for the missing organs as evidence. The accused posed as a doctor to convince associates of the false plan.

title: Sean Strickland turns Dustin Poirier’s viral IGBBMN phrase into a gym craze
content: Sean Strickland adopted Dustin Poirier's viral airport phrase, turning it into a running joke.  His gym teammates began shouting the acronym together, which became a team chant.  Strickland also put the phrase on merchandise and spray-painted it onto his truck.  He initially criticized Poirier's public statements about his struggles.  However, Strickland later expressed sympathy and defended Poirier's sponsorship situation.

title: Crude oil shock may squeeze affordable housing but premium homes stay resilient
content: Amid geopolitical uncertainties, India's real estate sector shows promising strength. A robust demand alongside improved developer finances is likely to mitigate immediate pressures. The luxury housing segment is expected to stay stable despite affordability hurdles, while both office leasing and industrial warehousing are anticipated to flourish. Continued institutional investment bodes well for the sector's long-term growth trajectory.

title: PNG push: Govt to offer distributors cheaper domestic gas for every new connection
content: Approved by the government and effective from September 1, the benefit will apply to new domestic PNG connections added above a specified threshold for each geographical area. India has around 17.4 million domestic PNG connections at present.

title: Cabinet clears 4 railway projects worth Rs 9,450 crore across 4 states: Key details
content: The Union Cabinet greenlit five significant infrastructure initiatives totaling over thirteen thousand crore rupees. Among these, four railway multitracking projects will extend the network by four hundred ten kilometers, alleviating congestion and enhancing freight transport across various states. Additionally, an NH-22 highway upgrade project in Bihar will improve the eighty-two kilometer stretch, bolstering connectivity with the Nepal border.

title: Navi Mumbai road rage: Ola driver thrashed, dragged 2km on car bonnet

He then lay on the car's bonnet to prevent the attacker's escape. The accused car driver sped away with the injured man on the hood. Police have registered an FIR and are searching for the absconding driver.

title: Manav Suthar's ten-wicket haul floors Sri Lanka as India conquer Galle challenge

The young left-arm spinner stamped his authority on a dramatic second session, picking up three wickets in an over to wrap up Sri Lanka's second innings quickly.

title: Russia turns to Asia for refined fuel, set to receive nearly 270,000 tonnes in Aug
content: Russia is importing refined fuel from Asian nations this month. Ukrainian attacks on its oil refineries have reduced domestic fuel production significantly. India supplies about one-third of these crucial refined fuel imports. These shipments use ship-to-ship transfers to obscure their origins. Russia has also tightened its own fuel export curbs to manage shortages.

title: Sam Burns reacts to LeBron James taking his golf game to YouTube

Burns believes James can significantly expand golf's global audience and reach. He also stated his desire to play a round of golf with James. James' first golf video has already garnered over two million views.

This development supports China's expanding satellite internet ambitions and global space market competition.
